```{{r setup, include=FALSE}}
# Load required packages
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(DT)
library(ggplot2)
library(rvest)

# -----------------------------
# Load and prepare the dataset
# -----------------------------
# IMPORTANT:
# Make sure "AIN Summary Page.html" is in the same "Final" folder as this Rmd.

ain_path <- "AIN Summary Page.html"

page <- read_html(ain_path)
tables <- html_table(page, fill = TRUE)

# Use the first (and only) table on the page
df_wide <- tables[[1]]

# Ensure first column is named "Categories"
names(df_wide)[1] <- "Categories"

# Clean numeric columns: remove asterisks, convert to numeric
for (col in names(df_wide)[-1]) {
df_wide[[col]] <- df_wide[[col]] %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_replace_all("\\*", "") %>%
    na_if("") %>%
    as.numeric()
}

date_cols <- names(df_wide)[-1]

# Long/tidy format: one row per category/date
df_long <- df_wide %>%
pivot_longer(
    cols = -Categories,
    names_to = "Date",
    values_to = "Count"
) %>%
mutate(
    Count = if_else(is.na(Count), 0, Count),
    Date = factor(Date, levels = date_cols, ordered = TRUE),
    Date_Index = as.integer(Date) - 1L
)

# Special summary categories (if they exist)
special_cats <- intersect(
c("All Aircraft Events", "Fatal Accidents"),
unique(df_long$Categories)
)

all_categories <- sort(unique(df_long$Categories))
default_category <- if (length(special_cats) > 0) special_cats[1] else all_categories[1]
```

```{r app, echo=TRUE}
# -----------------------------------------------
# Define the Shiny UI (with 4 tabs)
# -----------------------------------------------

ui <- navbarPage(
    "FAA Preliminary Accident & Incident Summary – TeamSolo_Nguyen_Final",
    
    # 1. OVERVIEW TAB (must be first)
    tabPanel(
        "Overview",
        sidebarLayout(
            sidebarPanel(
                h4("Controls (Overview)"),
                selectInput(
                    "overview_category",
                    "Select category/manufacturer:",
                    choices = all_categories,
                    selected = default_category
                )
            ),
            mainPanel(
                h3("Project Overview"),
                p(
                    "This Shiny application is built using the FAA ASIAS Preliminary Accident and Incident ",
                    "Reports AIN summary table. Each row in the data represents a category or manufacturer, ",
                    "and each column (after 'Categories') represents a date with the number of notices entered."
                ),
                p(
                    "The app provides an overview of the data, visualizations of event counts over time, ",
                    "an interactive table of the summary data, and a simple trend model that relates ",
                    "event counts to an ordered date index."
                ),
                hr(),
                h4("Key Dataset Information"),
                verbatimTextOutput("dataset_summary"),
                hr(),
                h4("Selected Category Snapshot Over Time"),
                plotOutput("overview_plot", height = "350px")
            )
        )
    ),
    
    # 2. VISUALIZATIONS TAB
    tabPanel(
        "Visualizations",
        sidebarLayout(
            sidebarPanel(
                h4("Visualization Controls"),
                selectInput(
                    "category_focus",
                    "Category/manufacturer for time trend:",
                    choices = all_categories,
                    selected = default_category
                ),
                radioButtons(
                    "chart_type",
                    "Time trend chart type:",
                    choices = c("Line", "Bar"),
                    selected = "Line"
                ),
                checkboxInput(
                    "log_scale",
                    "Use log scale for counts",
                    value = FALSE
                ),
                sliderInput(
                    "top_n",
                    "Top N manufacturers (by total events):",
                    min = 3,
                    max = min(15, length(all_categories)),
                    value = 5,
                    step = 1
                ),
                checkboxGroupInput(
                    "event_type_filter",
                    "Include summary categories (if available):",
                    choices = special_cats,
                    selected = special_cats
                )
            ),
            mainPanel(
                h3("Graphs Describing Project Outcomes"),
                fluidRow(
                    column(
                        width = 6,
                        h4("1. Time Trend for Selected Category"),
                        plotOutput("plot_category_trend", height = "320px")
                    ),
                    column(
                        width = 6,
                        h4("2. Fatal vs All Events Over Time"),
                        plotOutput("plot_fatal_vs_all", height = "320px")
                    )
                ),
                fluidRow(
                    column(
                        width = 6,

                        plotOutput("plot_top_manufacturers", height = "320px")
                    ),
                    column(
                        width = 6,
                        h4("4. Total Events per Date (All Categories)"),
                        plotOutput("plot_total_by_date", height = "320px")
                    )
                )
            )
        )
    ),
    
    # 3. TABLES TAB (interactive data table)
    tabPanel(
        "Tables",
        sidebarLayout(
            sidebarPanel(
                h4("Table Controls"),
                textInput(
                    "category_search",
                    "Search categories (contains, case-insensitive):",
                    value = ""
                ),

                )
            ),

                h3("Interactive Data Table"),

    # 4. MODEL TAB
    tabPanel(

                ),

# -----------------------------------------------
# Define the Shiny server logic
# -----------------------------------------------

server <- function(input, output, session) {
    
    # --------- Reactive helpers ---------
    
    category_overview_df <- reactive({
        df_long %>%
            filter(Categories == input$overview_category) %>%
            arrange(Date)
    })
    
    category_focus_df <- reactive({
        df_long %>%
            filter(Categories == input$category_focus) %>%
            arrange(Date)
    })
    
    fatal_all_df <- reactive({
        if (length(special_cats) == 0) {
            return(df_long[0, ])
        }
        df_long %>%
            filter(Categories %in% special_cats) %>%
            arrange(Categories, Date)
    })
    
    top_manufacturers_df <- reactive({
        # Exclude special summary categories
        df_long %>%
            filter(!Categories %in% special_cats) %>%
            group_by(Categories) %>%
            summarise(Total_Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop") %>%
            arrange(desc(Total_Count)) %>%
            slice_head(n = input$top_n)
    })
    
    total_by_date_df <- reactive({
        df_long %>%
            group_by(Date) %>%
            summarise(Total_Count = sum(Count), .groups = "drop")
    })
    
    model_df <- reactive({
        df_long %>%
            filter(Categories == input$model_category, Date_Index >= 0L) %>%
            arrange(Date_Index)
    })
    
    # --------- Overview outputs ---------
    
    output$dataset_summary <- renderText({
        n_cats <- n_distinct(df_long$Categories)
        n_dates <- n_distinct(df_long$Date)
        total_events <- sum(df_long$Count, na.rm = TRUE)
        
        paste(
            "Number of categories/manufacturers:", n_cats, "\n",
            "Number of dates (columns in AIN summary table):", n_dates, "\n",
            "Total events across all categories and dates:", total_events
        )
    })
    
    output$overview_plot <- renderPlot({
        df <- category_overview_df()
        
        if (nrow(df) == 0) {
            plot.new()
            text(0.5, 0.5, "No data for this category", cex = 1.2)
            return(invisible(NULL))
        }
        
        ggplot(df, aes(x = Date, y = Count, group = 1)) +
            geom_line() +
            geom_point() +
            labs(
                x = "Date entered",
                y = "Event count",
                title = paste("Events over time:", input$overview_category)
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    })
    
    # --------- Visualization outputs (4 graphics) ---------
    
    output$plot_category_trend <- renderPlot({
        df <- category_focus_df()
        
        if (nrow(df) == 0) {
            plot.new()
            text(0.5, 0.5, "No data for this category", cex = 1.2)
            return(invisible(NULL))
        }
        
        p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Date, y = Count, group = 1))
        
        if (input$chart_type == "Line") {
            p <- p + geom_line() + geom_point()
        } else {
            p <- p + geom_col()
        }
        
        if (isTRUE(input$log_scale)) {
            p <- p + scale_y_log10()
        }
        
        p +
            labs(
                x = "Date entered",
                y = "Event count",
                title = paste("Events over time:", input$category_focus)
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    })
    
    output$plot_fatal_vs_all <- renderPlot({
        df <- fatal_all_df()
        
        if (nrow(df) == 0 || length(input$event_type_filter) == 0) {
            plot.new()
            text(0.5, 0.5, "No summary categories available/selected", cex = 1.1)
            return(invisible(NULL))
        }
        
        df <- df %>%
            filter(Categories %in% input$event_type_filter)
        
        ggplot(df, aes(x = Date, y = Count, color = Categories, group = Categories)) +
            geom_line() +
            geom_point() +
            labs(
                x = "Date entered",
                y = "Event count",
                title = "Fatal vs All Events Over Time",
                color = "Category"
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    })
    
    output$plot_top_manufacturers <- renderPlot({
        df <- top_manufacturers_df()
        
        if (nrow(df) == 0) {
            plot.new()
            text(0.5, 0.5, "No manufacturer data available", cex = 1.1)
            return(invisible(NULL))
        }
        
        df <- df %>%
            arrange(Total_Count)
        
        ggplot(df, aes(x = Total_Count, y = reorder(Categories, Total_Count))) +
            geom_col() +
            labs(
                x = "Total events across all dates",
                y = "Manufacturer",
                title = paste("Top", input$top_n, "manufacturers by total events")
            ) +
            theme_minimal()
    })
    
    output$plot_total_by_date <- renderPlot({
        df <- total_by_date_df()
        
        ggplot(df, aes(x = Date, y = Total_Count)) +
            geom_col() +
            labs(
                x = "Date entered",
                y = "Total events (all categories)",
                title = "Total events per date"
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    })
    
    # --------- Tables (interactive data table) ---------
    
    output$table_snapshot <- DT::renderDataTable({
        df <- df_wide
        
        search <- str_trim(input$category_search)
        if (search != "") {
            df <- df %>%
                filter(str_detect(Categories, regex(search, ignore_case = TRUE)))
        }
        
        df <- head(df, input$max_rows)
        
        datatable(
            df,
            options = list(
                pageLength = min(10, nrow(df)),
                lengthChange = FALSE
            )
        )
    })
    
    # --------- Model (Count ~ Date_Index) ---------
    
    output$model_summary <- renderPrint({
        df <- model_df()
        
        if (nrow(df) < 2 || length(unique(df$Date_Index)) < 2) {
            cat(
                "Not enough data points to fit a model for this category.\n",
                "Please choose a different manufacturer/category."
            )
            return(invisible(NULL))
        }
        
        mod <- lm(Count ~ Date_Index, data = df)
        summary(mod)
    })
    
    output$model_plot <- renderPlot({
        df <- model_df()
        
        if (nrow(df) < 2 || length(unique(df$Date_Index)) < 2) {
            plot.new()
            text(0.5, 0.5, "Not enough data to fit model", cex = 1.2)
            return(invisible(NULL))
        }
        
        mod <- lm(Count ~ Date_Index, data = df)
        df$Pred <- predict(mod)
        
        ggplot(df, aes(x = Date_Index, y = Count)) +
            geom_point() +
            geom_line(aes(y = Pred), linewidth = 1) +
            scale_x_continuous(
                breaks = unique(df$Date_Index),
                labels = as.character(df$Date)
            ) +
            labs(
                x = "Date (ordered index)",
                y = "Event count",
                title = paste("Trend model fit:", input$model_category)
            ) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
    })
}

# Launch the app inside the RMarkdown document
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
